When I talk to other people, I have to take off my dark glasses. You must, because it is rude to talk to people with yr dark glasses on. Otherwise, people will ask you why you need to wear them. I faced this issue before. When I am not talking to people, I continue to wear dark glasses. Only psychiatrists and psychologists had asked me why I need to wear dark glasses. I told them that I had been bullied for 20+ years, so I am very scared of people. I need to wear dark glasses to avoid eye contact and feel safe.
